title: COVID vaccination and post-infection cancer signals: Evaluating patterns and potential biological mechanisms.
note: El-Deiry+Kuperwasser. Oncotarget 2026. WHY-axis keystone: 69 publications, 333 patients, 3 population cohorts (Italy ~300K, Korea ~8.4M, US military ~1.3M). Hematologic malignancies + solid tumors in temporal association with COVID-19 vaccination/infection. Senate hearing June 3 2026. Bridges VAERS pharmacovigilance signal (WHEN corpus) to cancer mechanism corpus (HOW). Recurrent themes: rapid progression/reactivation, tumor dormancy disruption, immune escape, microenvironmental shifts.
